title: Run Laya: small-business-loan (housing-lending, 3 cells, 5,500 requests)
description:
**Part of epic BD-4d61a6. Assigned to Ryan's MacBook Pro M3.** Follow the epic's instructions.

**Job:** Laya first pass on `small-business-loan` (housing-lending): 3 cells, 5,500 requests, at the 500-item cap.

Run these commands, one at a time, from the repository root (each resumes if interrupted):
```sh
PYTHONPATH=. var/laya-venv/bin/python scripts/answer_task.py small-business-loan owner-identity --item-cap 500 --build laya
```
```sh
PYTHONPATH=. var/laya-venv/bin/python scripts/answer_task.py small-business-loan owner-age --skip-as-written --item-cap 500 --build laya
```
```sh
PYTHONPATH=. var/laya-venv/bin/python scripts/answer_task.py small-business-loan race-name --skip-as-written --item-cap 500 --build laya
```

**Check:** each finished `answers/laya/small-business-loan/<plan>.jsonl.gz` must have exactly as many rows as that cue's `requests` in `docs/kev-runs/housing-lending/small-business-loan.json`.
**Then:** commit only the finished `.jsonl.gz` files to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push it; on `develop` comment the row counts, close, `kbs commit`, push `develop`.
